model.title: Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response

summary.text: This proposal aims to strengthen how the EU responds to civil protection emergencies and health crises by improving coordination and support among member states. It seeks to enhance preparedness and response capabilities so that countries can better handle large-scale disasters and health emergencies together.
